about: A sample conversation to test the talk box. The lines are placeholders written on 2026-11-13, not the owners' wording. Format: see scripts/talk_box.gd.

choices.say: This is a no-smoking studio. You know that, right?
Heard the new single. You rhymed "crime" with "crime".
I'm cutting a record about jaywalkers. You want a verse?

smoke.speaker: npc
smoke.line: Ain't nobody smoking. That's the mixing board. It's been doing that since Tuesday.

rhyme.speaker: npc
rhyme.line: That's called emphasis, playboy. Look it up.

jaywalk.speaker: npc
jaywalk.line: I don't cross streets. Streets come to me.

choices.say: I'm going to have to report that board to the fire marshal.
Just say no. To all of it. Whatever it is.
Be honest. Are you wearing a wire? Because I am.

marshal.speaker: npc
marshal.line: You do that. Tell him he still owes me twenty.

say_no.speaker: npc
say_no.line: I been saying no since you walked in. You still here.

wire.speaker: npc
wire.line: ...And that's why nobody books the booth after you.
